summary: Roast any AI agent idea from your IDE: verdict tier, readiness score, top risk, shareable URL.
offersHint: Roast any AI agent idea from your IDE: verdict tier, readiness score, top risk, shareable URL. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://whycantwehaveanagentforthis.com/api/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your MCP access token>. Required — request one from the operator. Machine access only, not a human signup.

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer <your MCP access token>. Required — request one from the operator. Machine access only, not a human signup.

toolsPreview.name: roast_idea
toolsPreview.description: Get the full whycantwehaveanagentforthis.com roast for an AI agent idea: the verdict tier, an agent-readiness score (0-100 + band), the top OWASP-MCP security risk, the "you're the X% who…" framing, and a shareable /result URL. Every call mints a real, persistent result page (its own OG share card) — so roasting from your IDE also publishes it. Anonymous (no token): 3/hour, 10/day. Add a token for higher limits.

toolsPreview.name: get_verdict
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a verdict that was already minted, by its result id or slug. Read-only — no new analysis, no rate-limit cost. Returns the same structured verdict shape as roast_idea.

toolsPreview.name: get_stats
toolsPreview.description: Live public numbers for whycantwehaveanagentforthis.com: total ideas roasted, live results, % told to ship, % that already exist, roast battles, and how many roasts came in via MCP. Read-only, no rate-limit cost.

toolsPreview.name: browse_explore
toolsPreview.description: Page through existing public roasts (the /explore feed) with their shareable /result URLs. Optional free-text query and sort (newest | top | money). Read-only, no rate-limit cost — use it to see whether an idea was already roasted before minting a new one.
